summary: Tested printer settings feature (admin UI + backend + kiosk APK PRINT_RECEIPT). All 11 backend pytest cases pass. Admin UI works and persists settings. Mobile has no overflow. The sendApkPrint pipeline sends a single PRINT_RECEIPT message to window.ReactNativeWebView.postMessage with the expected shape: {type:'PRINT_RECEIPT', command, printer:{type,command,paper,width_mm,chars_per_line,configured}, data:{naam,appartement,bedrag,methode,datum,kwitantie}} and the '[APK PRINT_RECEIPT]' console log appears. Found 1 CRITICAL dependency bug (fixed) and 1 UX bug (no <Toaster/> mounted).

ui_bugs.issue: Imports 'sonner' which was NOT installed in package.json → React threw 'Cannot find module sonner' and <InstellingenHub> error-boundaried to blank orange page, breaking ALL Instellingen tabs. Fixed by running `yarn add sonner` (sonner@2.0.8 added).

No <Toaster/> from sonner is mounted anywhere in the app (searched entire src). Therefore toast.success/toast.error inside PrinterSettings do not render any visible toast to the user — save/error feedback is silent. Either mount <Toaster/> in App.jsx or refactor PrinterSettings to use the project's inline toast pattern (see LiveLandingEditor.jsx).

action_items: Mount <Toaster/> from sonner in the main App layout (or replace sonner usage in PrinterSettings.jsx with project's inline toast pattern) so admin save/error feedback is visible.
Consider adding 'sonner' explicitly to package.json dependencies via a committed change (I ran `yarn add sonner` which updated package.json and yarn.lock) — verify it was persisted.
critical_code_review_comments: PrinterSettings.jsx uses `sonner` toast API but sonner was never a project dependency — missing dep caused Instellingen hub to crash. Always verify imports resolve.

Backend endpoints are clean: scope() isolation on admin PUT, kiosk endpoint uses kiosk_scope + ignores unknown IDs with safe defaults. chars_per_line math correct (58→32, 80→48, custom width round(w*0.6) e.g. 72→43).

sendApkPrint silently swallows GET /kiosk/printer-settings errors (catch/console.warn) — if backend 500s, printer field will be undefined but msg still sent with command=undefined. Consider sending a safe default from the FE too.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (printer-settings UI, persistence, mobile layout, kiosk PRINT_RECEIPT structure/data fields all verified; visual toast rendering not working due to missing Toaster)

rca of the issue: Root cause of the blank Printers tab: PrinterSettings.jsx had `import { toast } from 'sonner'` but 'sonner' was not in package.json. Webpack dev build threw 'Cannot find module sonner' at component load; the parent InstellingenHub lost its render tree and showed only the orange SPA splash. Reproduction: navigate to /{slug}/admin/instellingen#printers → blank. Fix: `yarn add sonner` (done). Follow-up: no <Toaster/> is mounted, so toasts remain silent — main agent should mount it in root App.
